title: blephariglottis albiflora f. holopetala
intro: Blephariglottis albiflora f. holopetala, commonly known as "Ghost Orchid", is a rare and endangered terrestrial orchid native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including the relief of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Blephariglottis albiflora f. holopetala include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
